T: Bread from the baker, beans from Jack, and a pie for Granny.
D: A childless baker and his wife set off into the forest to lift a witch's curse, crossing paths with Cinderella, Little Red Riding Hood, Jack and Rapunzel.
P: Serve the snacks when Little Red Riding Hood turns up at the bakery and fills her basket.
S: Little Red's basket cheese and herb buns
Little Red filling her basket at the bakery for Granny, and eating half of it on the way

Soft pull-apart bread buns with cheddar, chives and thyme, baked golden with a melted cheese top. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp caster sugar, 1 tsp salt, 300ml warm milk and 40g soft butter and knead for 10 minutes. Knead in 100g grated cheddar, 2 tbsp chopped chives and 1 tsp thyme leaves. Cover and prove for 1 hour until doubled. Divide into 12 balls and set close together in a lined 23cm square tin, then prove for 30 minutes. Brush with beaten egg, scatter with another 50g cheddar and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden. Cool for 10 minutes and pull apart into a basket.
Jack swapping his cow for a handful of beans

Toasted baguette with ricotta and bright crushed broad beans, mint, garlic and lemon. Cook 500g frozen broad beans in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain and cool, then pop the beans out of their skins. Crush roughly with 1 crushed garlic clove, the zest and juice of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp chopped mint and 40ml olive oil, and season. Brush 1cm slices of baguette with the rest of 80ml oil and toast until golden. Spread with 150g ricotta and pile on the beans.
M: Granny's cottage chicken and mushroom pot pie
Granny's cottage on the far side of the forest

Chicken thigh, leek, mushrooms and thyme in a creamy mustard sauce under a deep golden puff pastry lid. Season 800g diced boneless chicken thighs and brown in 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan, then lift out. Soften 1 sliced leek, 250g halved button mushrooms, 2 crushed garlic cloves and the leaves from 3 thyme sprigs in the pan. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock, 150ml thickened cream and 1 tsp Dijon mustard. Return the chicken and simmer for 15 minutes until thick. Stir in 2 tbsp chopped parsley, season and spoon into a 2 litre pie dish, then cool for 10 minutes. Cover with 2 sheets of puff pastry, press the edges, brush with beaten egg, cut a steam hole and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
King's festival roast pork with apples
crackling loin on apples, onions and sage, cider gravy, buttered greens, before the pitch trap

Crackling pork loin roasted on apples and onions, with cider gravy and buttered greens. Heat the oven to 240C. Score the skin, rub with the salt and sit the pork on the quartered apples, onions and sage in a roasting tin. Roast for 30 minutes until the skin crackles, then turn down to 180C. Roast for 1 more hour, then rest for 15 minutes. Stir the flour into the pan juices on the stove, add the cider and simmer for 4 minutes for gravy. Boil the beans for 4 minutes, then toss with the spinach and butter until wilted. Carve and serve with the roast apples, gravy and greens.
W: Rapunzel's long golden hair hanging from the tower window

Soft buttery sweet bread twisted into a long plait around cinnamon apple, glazed with honey, with whipped cream. Mix 400g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g caster sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 150ml warm milk and 2 eggs, then knead in 80g soft butter bit by bit until glossy. Prove for 1 1/2 hours until doubled. Roll out to 40cm by 30cm, spread with 30g soft butter and scatter with 60g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 grated, squeezed green apples. Roll up from a long side, cut in half lengthways and twist the two strands together, cut sides up, into a long plait. Prove on a lined tray for 30 minutes, then bake at 180C for 30 minutes until deep golden. Brush with 2 tbsp warm honey and serve in slices with 200ml lightly whipped cream.
K: Vanilla shake for Milky White, as white as milk

Thick, frothy cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream, vanilla and a little honey, dusted with nutmeg. Blend 800ml cold milk, 6 scoops of vanilla ice cream, 1 tsp vanilla extract and 1 tbsp honey until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses and dust each with a pinch of ground nutmeg.

dishes.n: Little Red's basket cheese and herb buns
dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and keep in an airtight tin; warm at 180C for 5 minutes. The dough can do its first prove overnight in the fridge

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, warm milk and butter and knead for 10 minutes until smooth. Knead in two thirds of the cheddar with the chives and thyme.
Cover and prove until doubled.
Divide into 12 and roll into tight balls. Set them close together in a lined 23cm square tin.
Cover and prove until puffy and touching. Heat the oven to 200C.
Brush with the egg, scatter with the rest of the cheddar and bake until golden.
Cool for 10 minutes, then pull apart into a cloth-lined basket.

dishes.make_ahead: Crush the beans up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge with a film of oil on top; toast the bread up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Cook the broad beans in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain and cool in cold water.
Pop the bright green beans out of their pale skins.
Crush roughly with the garlic, lemon zest and juice, mint and half the oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Brush the baguette slices with the rest of the oil and toast under the grill until golden.
Spread each toast with ricotta and pile on the crushed beans.

dishes.n: Granny's cottage chicken and mushroom pot pie
dishes.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead and chill; top with pastry and bake on the night

steps.text: Season the chicken and brown it in the butter and oil in a large frying pan. Lift out.
Soften the leek, button mushrooms, garlic and thyme in the same pan.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream and mustard. Return the browned filling and simmer until thick.
Stir in the parsley, season and spoon into a 2 litre pie dish. Cool for 10 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lay the pastry over the top, overlapping the sheets, trim and press the edges, brush with the egg and cut a small steam hole.
Bake until puffed and deep golden.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

steps.text: Brown the Swiss brown mushrooms hard in the butter and oil in a large frying pan, then stir in the butter beans and lift out.
Soften the leek, button mushrooms, garlic and thyme in the same pan.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream and mustard. Return the browned filling and simmer until thick.
Stir in the parsley, season and spoon into a 2 litre pie dish. Cool for 10 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lay the pastry over the top, overlapping the sheets, trim and press the edges, brush with the egg and cut a small steam hole.
Bake until puffed and deep golden.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

veg.n: King's festival roast pumpkin with apples
veg.make_ahead: Cut the pumpkin up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Toss pumpkin wedges with the oil and salt and roast at 200C on the quartered apples, onions and sage for 45 minutes until caramelised.
Melt half the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the apple juice and stock and simmer for 5 minutes for gravy.
Boil the beans for 4 minutes, then toss with the spinach and the rest of the butter until wilted.
Serve the pumpkin and apples with the gravy and greens.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and keep wrapped; the dough can do its first prove overnight in the fridge

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, caster sugar, salt, warm milk and eggs, then knead in the dough butter bit by bit until smooth and glossy.
Cover and prove until doubled.
Squeeze the apple dry. Roll the dough out to 40cm by 30cm, spread with the filling butter and scatter with the brown sugar, cinnamon and apple.
Roll up from a long side, cut in half lengthways and twist the two strands together, cut sides up, into a long plait. Set on a lined tray.
Cover loosely and prove until puffy. Heat the oven to 180C.
Bake until deep golden and cooked through.
Brush with the warmed honey, cool a little and serve in slices with the cream, lightly whipped.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the milk and glasses up to 1 day ahead; blend to order

steps.text: Blend the milk, ice cream, vanilla and honey until thick and frothy.
Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses.
Dust each with a pinch of nutmeg and serve with a straw.
